verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke is an international law firm selling legal advisory services (venture financing, IP, data privacy, immigration), not a software platform, so subscribing to events via webhooks is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships an event-subscription capability: its online investor-readiness tool and UPC tracker are informational web resources, and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes both returned 404.
